task: ae.tar: strict POSIX ustar/pax tar codec (Entry, TarWriter, TarReader) plus traversal-safe TarExtractor, differential-tested against GNU tar
reasoning_summary: Wrote design and 141 tests first (literal header bytes computed independently in Python, pax record length boundary, per-rule re-sealed crafted headers with controls, truncation and flip-every-byte loops, GNU tar listing/extraction/creation oracles). Implementation passed after fixing test-side issues (wrong hand checksum literal, GNU 32-bit id limit, non-UTF-8 JVM file names, GNU directory-time heuristic). A 65-mutant pass left 14 survivors; 11 were test gaps and were closed, 3 are justified equivalents.
